thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: high_latency_slo_burn triggered for service=redwood-inference-hosted-usw2. Escalation policy: oncall -> sre-lead. Triggered at 2026-03-14T10:14:38Z. Details: p99 latency > 2s for 5m on /v1/generate (region=us-west-2)

alex (oncall): Acked. I'm on it. Starting quick triage. @michelle @jordan FYI.

michelle (eng-sre): Thanks Alex. Any suppression or recent deploys?

alex (oncall): Noted. No user-facing deploys in last 30m per deploy-bot. I see a rise in tail latency across multiple model routes. Quick grafana snapshot: p95 ~ 800ms -> 1.4s, p99 ~ 2.1s -> 3.5s.

sam (platform): I'm seeing a surge of concurrent connections from a single tenant in us-west-2 (tenant=acme-inc). Could be a traffic spike. forwarding flow logs.

jordan (sre lead): If it's single-tenant we should consider throttling or routing them to dedicated capacity. Any sign of KV cache eviction or queue depth rising?

alex (oncall): KV cache hit rate dropped from 89% to 41% in the last 4m. Also GPU util on pool-usw2-g1 at 96%. KV cache evictions spiked.

michelle (eng-sre): That suggests cache thrash under hot prefixes. Can you paste the query you ran?

alex (oncall): Ran this PromQL in observability:
```
sum by (route) (increase(inference_request_duration_seconds_bucket{le=\"\"} [5m]))
/ sum by (route) (increase(inference_request_duration_seconds_count[5m]))
```
It showed heavy tail on /v1/generate-chat and /v1/embeddings for acme-inc.

sam (platform): Also seeing autoscaler refusing to add nodes — failed to allocate g4dn due to quota. Error from cloud-api: 
```
QuotaExceeded: Requested vCPU limit 0 -> 64 not available in region
```

jordan (sre lead): Ok mitigation options: 1) throttle acme-inc at the edge, 2) route excess requests to fallback smaller model, 3) increase pool by emergency capacity (if quota allows), 4) restart a subset of serving pools to clear KV pressure (risky). Thoughts?

alex (oncall): I'm going to attempt a soft throttle at the ingress for acme-inc (rate-limit to 1.5x their baseline) to reduce burst. Applying now.

alex (oncall): Applied temporary rate-limit rule: `ingress-ratelimit: tenant=acme-inc, qps=2500` — patch applied.

incident-bot: Rate limit rule change deployed (ci-deploy-bot). Change id: ci-34567.

michelle (eng-sre): Good. Also enabling fallback routing for non-streaming requests to model=gpt-small-fallback for that tenant. Toggle in routing-service.

sam (platform): Submitting emergency capacity request to cloud: ticket 789234. Waiting on approval.

alex (oncall): Observability update: 2m after throttle p95 dropped to 600ms, p99 to 1.1s. CPU on GPU hosts still high but KV hit rate recovered to 76%.

jordan (sre lead): Nice, looks like throttle helped. Keep throttling for now and monitor TD. We should also start a controlled restart of the busiest worker pods to reclaim memory — schedule one by one.

alex (oncall): Kicking rolling restart on serving-group-usw2-rt: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/serve-usw2 --namespace=prod` with maxUnavailable=1.

michelle (eng-sre): I'll watch the trace samples for any quality regressions from fallback routing. Early check: completions look functionally intact for non-stream paths.

pd-manager (pagerduty-bot): PagerDuty note: escalation to ops-manager if not resolved in 15 minutes.

alex (oncall): Noted. Updating status to 'mitigated' for now. Will continue to monitor for 30m before handing off.

sam (platform): Cloud ticket approved partially — +16 vCPU immediate, will take ~6m to provision. If throttle holds, we may not need it.

jordan (sre lead): Customer impact note for postmortem: brief SLO burn from 10:12–10:28 UTC for hosted-usw2 affecting tails; impacted customers: acme-inc and a small subset of multi-tenant spikes. No data loss reported.

alex (oncall): Confirming with support: no new user complaints yet, but internal synthetic checks saw timeouts for streaming sessions. Filed incident stub: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026

michelle (eng-sre): I'm taking the active investigation for detailed root cause. Alex — please hand over monitoring and any traces you collected.

alex (oncall): Handoff: I checked logs, KV eviction patterns, and applied throttle + rollback routing. Link to traces: https://observability.redwood/team/trace/1919005678. I'm available on pager for quick questions.

incident-bot: Incident status changed to 'investigating' -> 'mitigated' by alex (oncall). PagerDuty incident remains open until owner closes.

michelle (eng-sre): I'll continue and update this thread with timeline and a proposed postmortem. Reassigning to michelle (eng-sre).

alex (oncall): Thanks — closing my oncall shift notes here.

michelle (eng-sre): Update at 10:44 UTC: metrics stable, p99 back under 900ms. Keeping mitigations for 30m and will prepare RCA draft. Marking this thread as ongoing for the postmortem collection. :memo:
